answer: What survives to the jetty is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The glacier is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the grove.
